methodological_note: The final fusion demo model uses only session-aligned multimodal rows. Webcam calibration videos are not inserted as independent fusion observations. Instead, the separately trained webcam-calibrated image classifier is applied to the CLIP embedding belonging to each aligned session image. Its four behavioural-state probabilities and confidence statistics are appended as image-derived fusion features. This preserves the original multimodal session alignment while allowing the live webcam domain calibration to influence final fusion.
